text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy, I saw
Bamboo Memory and Sakura Chiyono O side by side
in a mysterious pose.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not even wavering after that special training...!
Way to go, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Though honestly, my legs are definitely feeling it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer! The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Bamboo Memory swing a shinai,
Sakura Chiyono O apparently asked
to be taught kendo, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san's sword form was just so beautiful
that I couldn't help but admire it...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, you can't refuse when it's put like that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So with that, I had them start by practicing the fundamental sonkyo squat posture—bending their knees and lowering their hips!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The sonkyo squat is training to center your mind!
Dad always said—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The sonkyo crouch is also part of the match.
How much you value etiquette and respect
shows right here," or so I was taught!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's start the next special training soon!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright! Next up is one lap around the track with sliding steps!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? By shuffling your feet!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! As they say,
"If your basics are solid, you become unshakable"—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right! Come, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Here's the final one!
Shall we try swinging the shinai?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to conclude the full-course fundamentals training,
Sakura Chiyono O demonstrated her shinai swings, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without any hint of flattery,
the sight of Sakura Chiyono O swinging her shinai
was truly pure and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I swung it... perfectly! I did it too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright!! We did it, didn't we!
It was super pretty!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all...!
It's all thanks to you, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm the one who should be thanking you! Thanks to you, I feel like I've gotten closer to my idol!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"My father is an honest and upright person,
and he's who I aspire to be."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Your dad is... your goal...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today, by using the method my dad taught me,
I was able to get proper results...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that mean you're one step closer to your dream, though!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So if I keep pushing at this pace,
I know for sure I can stand alongside my idol!!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can become that.
Maybe I'll have them teach me too.
Maybe I'll have them teach me too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So if I keep pushing at this pace,
I know for sure I can stand alongside my idol!!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can become that.
Maybe I'll have them teach me too.
Maybe I'll have them teach me too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you think so?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I mean, no, sir!
I gotta keep lookin' dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Whenever I won a match, Dad would
say that to keep himself grounded!
...Though he was grinning a bit while saying it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"As someone I look up to and strive to become, I felt I just had to secure it!!
...Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While I knew it was hardly something to respect,
it was too amusing, so I intentionally
kept my mouth shut."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Are you interested too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then let's start by centering our minds in the crouch stance!
Alright, beginnnn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No time like the present!
You're my Trainer, after all,
so I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with Bamboo Memory's encouragement,
I was only taught the sonkyo crouch for the day.
